title: Copilot Dashboard: highlights of Copilot adoption from Viva Engage posts
summary: The briefing passes: the planned feature and rollout facts match the roadmap, and Microsoft documents the existing dashboard and web app controls it gives. Feature-specific defaults, licensing tiers and privacy behaviour remain unpublished. Minor corrections would complete the dashboard access path and clarify the automatic-access criteria.

claims.quote: The Copilot Dashboard showcases real-world success stories, user-shared excitement about new Copilot features, and vibrant community discussions. These examples offer a qualitative view

Name : DisableFeatureForAll

Everyone

Retain the existing Before rollout review path.

Keep the separate analyst, delegate, manager and PIM statements.
